meta.title: IT-Wallet Attestations Explorer and Demo
meta.description: Search and explore IT-Wallet attestations from the public registry: catalog, schemas, claims, authentic sources, taxonomy, and demo credentials.
meta.tagline: Search the public registry, inspect issuer metadata, and preview demo credentials.

search.label: Search the registry
search.hint: Use +, -, quotes, OR, parentheses, * ? and field:value. The menus write legal_type:, issuer:, as: and claim:.

example.heading: Demo credential
example.disclaimer: This demo credential is for illustration only and must not be treated as usable. It is issued with the fake issuer https://demo.issuer.wallet.example and the ES256 keys published under {{keys}}. It is not a real attestation: claims are synthetic and it must not be used in a Wallet, in production, or for verification.
example.empty: No schema in the dump to build a demo credential from.
example.error: Could not sign the demo credential.
example.cardHint: Smartcard-style preview. Name, colours and claim labels come from credential_configuration_id when the metadata includes them; otherwise a fallback style is used. Illustration only.

issuer.heading: Credential issuer
issuer.empty: No OpenID4VCI issuer metadata in the dump for this credential type.

offer.heading: Credential Offer
offer.disclaimer: Credential offer generated from the catalog. Without an encrypted issuer_state it only enables a request for a credential type after authentication (if eligible). The form below is an example: it does not use the PDND GetAttributeClaims key.
offer.urnMissing: URN cannot be built: authentic source entity_id or dataset_id is missing.
offer.objectIdHint: Identifier of the instance at the Authentic Source. If empty, the URN omits the objectId segment.
offer.publicKeyHint: RSA-OAEP-256 / A256GCM. Pre-filled with the published demo public key. If set, the URN is encrypted and placed in grants.authorization_code.issuer_state.
offer.decryptHint: Matching private key: demo/keys/issuer-state-enc.private.jwk.json (or .pem). Demo material only — not the PDND GetAttributeClaims key.
offer.decryptHelp: From a clone of this repository, run the command below. It uses the published fake RSA private key. OpenSSL is a poor fit for this JWE; use the Node script.
offer.decrypted: issuer_state decrypted with the demo private key
offer.encryptError: Could not encrypt the URN with the given key.
offer.derivedIds: credential_configuration_ids derived from schemas (issuer OpenID4VCI metadata not in the dump).
